message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover featuring a large red logo "TEMPO" at the top. Below the logo, two people lie on a white mattress that has been torn down the center. The tear forms the jagged silhouette of a human facial profile facing right.

On the left side of the mattress, a man with brown hair and a beard wearing blue pajamas lies in a fetal position. He has one hand to his head and his eyes are closed. On the right side of the mattress, a smaller man with short hair wearing red pajamas also lies in a fetal position, facing away from the first man. He has his hands near his face.

The background is a solid tan color. Black text in the bottom right corner reads "PISAH JALAN MANTAN SEKONDAN," followed by a paragraph of smaller Indonesian text and "H.26." Additional text at the top includes "Jejaring Makelar Kasus Sekretaris MA H.62" and "Kisruh Dana Talangan Minyak Goreng H.72." A barcode and date "15-21 MEI 2023" are also visible.
